crossRefs.note: “Therefore listen to me, you men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness, from the Almighty…
that he would show you the secrets of wisdom! For true wisdom has two sides. Know therefore that God exacts of you less…
“After all that has come on us for our evil deeds, and for our great guilt, since you, our God, have punished us less…
You are righteous, Yahweh. Your judgments are upright.
He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a dimly burning wick. He will faithfully bring justice.
“Lord, righteousness belongs to you, but to us confusion of face, as it is today; to the men of Judah, and to the…
For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, that we should come together in judgment.
There is no umpire between us, that might lay his hand on us both.
that he would maintain the right of a man with God, of a son of man with his neighbor!
There the upright might reason with him, so I should be delivered forever from my judge.
Yahweh says, “What unrighteousness have your fathers found in me, that they have gone far from me, and have walked…
But indeed, O man, who are you to reply against God? Will the thing formed ask him who formed it, “Why did you make me…

translations.web: For he doesn’t need to consider a man further, that he should go before God in judgment.
translations.bsb: For God need not examine a man further or have him approach for judgment.
translations.kjv: For he will not lay upon man more than right; that he should enter into judgment with God.
translations.asv: For he needeth not further to consider a man, That he should go before God in judgment.
